guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：非球面光學加工
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Aspheric-optics manufacturing
guides.concept: 以一片半徑 50 mm、口徑 50 mm 的拋物面為貫穿案例：先用矢高方程算出它與球面的偏離量與斜率，說明為何無法用標準球面工法與干涉儀直接處理，再拆解 CNC 研磨、磁流變等確定性次口徑拋光的去除率與收斂、單點鑽石車削的理論粗糙度與精密玻璃模造的收縮補償，接著以輪廓儀、CGH 干涉與拼接量測建立誤差預算，最後以對心公差、熱穩定性與 ISO 10110 圖面完成驗收交接。
guides.conceptEn: Using a paraboloid of 50 mm radius and 50 mm aperture as the running case, the course first computes its departure from a sphere and its slope with the sag equation to show why standard spherical methods and interferometers cannot handle it directly, then dissects CNC grinding, the removal rate and convergence of deterministic subaperture polishing such as MRF, the theoretical roughness of single-point diamond turning and the shrinkage compensation of precision glass molding, builds an error budget from profilometry, CGH interferometry and stitching, and finishes with centring tolerances, thermal stability and ISO 10110 drawing-based acceptance.
procedure: 球面只有一個自由度（曲率），無法同時滿足聚焦與消球差，所以 f 數小的鏡片必須多片組合；非球面以矢高方程 z(r) = c·r²/[1 + √(1 − (1+k)c²r²)] + Σ A₂ᵢ·r²ⁱ 加入圓錐常數 k 與高次項，一面就能消除球差。代價是表面不再有旋轉對稱球面那種「任何方向都一樣」的性質：曲率隨半徑變化，傳統靠工具與工件互磨自然成形的球面工法失效，量測也不能直接用球面參考波前。偏離量與斜率的大小決定了加工與量測方法。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「非球面矢高方程與圓錐常數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

非球面加工的誤差按空間頻率分成三段：低頻面形誤差對應像差，可由後續修形去除；中頻漣波（週期約 0.1 到 10 mm）是次口徑工具沿軌跡留下的週期結構，會把光散射到像點附近形成小角度的眩光與對比損失；高頻粗糙度造成大角度散射。球面全口徑拋光天然不產生中頻，而非球面依賴小工具，所以中頻誤差成為非球面特有的品質問題，必須用功率譜密度（PSD）而不是單一的 PV 或 RMS 數字來規範。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「表面誤差功率譜密度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

非球面先以 CNC 金剛石砂輪依矢高方程研磨成形，留下數微米的面形誤差與次表面損傷層，再進入確定性拋光：磁流變拋光（MRF）、氣囊拋光或小工具電腦控制拋光都以一個已校正的工具去除函數（TIF）在表面上移動，停留時間圖由誤差圖與 TIF 的反卷積求得，去除量與停留時間成正比。每次疊代把誤差降低一個收斂比，通常需要兩到三次量測與拋光循環；MRF 的剪切去除機制幾乎不施壓，因此不會引入新的次表面損傷。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「CNC 研磨與磁流變拋光頭」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

金屬、紅外晶體與塑膠的非球面常以單點鑽石車削直接成形：工件在空氣主軸上旋轉，鑽石刀尖沿非球面軌跡以奈米級解析度進給，表面粗糙度由進給量與刀尖半徑決定，形狀精度由機台的定位精度與熱穩定性決定。大量生產的玻璃非球面則用精密玻璃模造：玻璃預形體加熱到轉變溫度以上，在碳化鎢或碳化矽模具之間壓製成形後緩慢冷卻；模具本身是以研磨拋光做出的非球面，並且必須預先補償玻璃冷卻收縮與折射率因冷卻速率下降的效應。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鑽石車刀與玻璃模具」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

非球面與球面參考波前干涉時，條紋密度由偏離斜率決定，超過相機解析度就無法量測，因此需要讓參考波前變成非球面的零位元件：電腦全像片（CGH）以繞射產生設計波前，或用折射式零位鏡；另一條路是不做零位而用次口徑拼接或傾斜波干涉儀。接觸式與光學輪廓儀逐點掃描剖面，不受斜率的條紋限制但速度慢、取樣稀，且探針半徑與斜率會產生系統性的量測誤差。工程上通常以輪廓儀做前段加工的量測，以 CGH 干涉做最終驗收。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「輪廓儀探針與 CGH 零位鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

球面沒有軸，任何通過球心的直線都是對稱軸；非球面卻有唯一的對稱軸，它與鏡片的機械軸（外圓）或另一面的光軸若不重合，整個偏離量分佈就相對光瞳平移，產生與偏心量乘以局部斜率成正比的彗差型表面誤差。因此非球面的誤差預算除了面形、中頻與粗糙度，還要包含非球面軸的偏心與傾斜、中心厚度與頂點位置，這些量在球面鏡片上幾乎不需要關心。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「非球面軸與機械軸偏心」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

非球面鏡片裝入鏡筒時以邊緣與斜面定位，夾持力與黏著劑收縮都可能把面形壓變形；材料的選擇決定熱穩定性：玻璃的 dn/dT 與熱膨脹都很小，塑膠的 dn/dT 為負且數量級大一百倍，模造玻璃居中。整合時要用熱光系數估算焦距隨溫度的漂移，並決定是否需要被動無熱化（混合不同材料）或主動對焦。鏡筒材料的膨脹也會改變鏡片間距，與鏡片本身的效應同時計入。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鏡筒介面與熱膨脹」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

非球面的圖面依 ISO 10110 系列標示：非球面方程與係數、面形公差（PV、RMS 與斜率）、中頻 PSD 或帶限 RMS、粗糙度、對心公差與中心厚度，每一項都要指明量測方法與去除的擬合項（例如扣除傾斜與離焦）。驗收報告要附上量測不確定度，依慣例量測不確定度應小於公差的四分之一（量測比 4:1）；達不到時需要改進量測或用兩種獨立方法交叉驗證。交接文件還要包含實測的矢高表或面形圖檔，供光學設計做「實測重最佳化」。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ISO 10110 圖面與量測不確定度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A sphere has a single degree of freedom, its curvature, and cannot focus and cancel spherical aberration at once, so fast lenses need many elements; an asphere adds a conic constant k and higher-order terms through the sag equation z(r) = c·r²/[1 + √(1 − (1+k)c²r²)] + Σ A₂ᵢ·r²ⁱ and removes spherical aberration with one surface. The price is losing the property of a sphere that every direction is alike: curvature varies with radius, so traditional spherical lapping in which tool and part grind each other into shape no longer works, and testing cannot simply use a spherical reference wavefront. The magnitude of departure and slope decides which fabrication and metrology methods apply. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Aspheric sag equation and conic constant”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Errors in aspheric fabrication fall into three spatial-frequency bands: low-frequency figure error maps to aberration and can be corrected by subsequent figuring; mid-spatial-frequency ripple (periods of roughly 0.1 to 10 mm) is the periodic structure left along the tool path by subaperture tools and scatters light close to the image point as small-angle flare with contrast loss; high-frequency roughness scatters at large angles. Full-aperture spherical polishing produces no mid-frequency content naturally, whereas aspheres depend on small tools, so mid-spatial-frequency error is a quality problem specific to aspheres that must be specified with a power spectral density rather than a single PV or RMS number. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Surface-error power spectral density”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An asphere is first ground to the sag equation with a CNC diamond wheel, leaving several micrometres of figure error and a subsurface damage layer, then enters deterministic polishing: magnetorheological finishing (MRF), bonnet polishing or computer-controlled small-tool polishing all move a calibrated tool influence function (TIF) over the surface, the dwell-time map is obtained by deconvolving the error map with the TIF, and removal is proportional to dwell time. Each iteration reduces the error by a convergence ratio, so two or three measure-and-polish cycles are usual; the shear-based removal of MRF applies almost no pressure and introduces no new subsurface damage. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CNC grinding and MRF polishing head”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Aspheres in metals, infrared crystals and plastics are often shaped directly by single-point diamond turning: the part rotates on an air-bearing spindle while a diamond tool follows the aspheric path with nanometre feed resolution; roughness is set by feed and tool-nose radius, and form accuracy by the machine's positioning accuracy and thermal stability. High-volume glass aspheres use precision glass molding instead: a glass preform is heated above its transition temperature, pressed between tungsten-carbide or silicon-carbide molds and cooled slowly; the molds are themselves ground and polished aspheres and must pre-compensate the shrinkage of the glass on cooling and the refractive-index drop caused by the cooling rate. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Diamond tool and glass mold”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

When an asphere interferes with a spherical reference wavefront the fringe density is set by the departure slope, and beyond the camera's resolution nothing can be measured, so a null element must turn the reference into the aspheric wavefront: a computer-generated hologram (CGH) produces the design wavefront by diffraction, or a refractive null lens does; the alternative is to avoid a null and use subaperture stitching or a tilted-wave interferometer. Contact and optical profilometers scan profiles point by point, free of the fringe limit but slow and sparse, with systematic errors from stylus radius and slope. In practice profilometry serves the early fabrication stages and CGH interferometry the final acceptance. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Profilometer stylus and CGH null”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A sphere has no axis, since any line through its centre is an axis of symmetry; an asphere has a unique symmetry axis, and if it does not coincide with the mechanical axis of the lens edge or the optical axis of the other surface, the whole departure map shifts relative to the pupil, producing a coma-like surface error proportional to decentration times local slope. The error budget of an asphere therefore includes, beyond figure, mid-frequency and roughness, the decentration and tilt of the aspheric axis, the centre thickness and the vertex position, quantities that hardly matter for spherical elements. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Aspheric axis versus mechanical axis”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An asphere is located in its barrel by its edge and a bevel, and clamping force or adhesive shrinkage can distort the figure; the material choice sets thermal stability, since glass has small dn/dT and expansion, plastic has a negative dn/dT a hundred times larger, and molded glass lies between. Integration uses the thermo-optic coefficients to estimate focal-length drift with temperature and to decide whether passive athermalisation by mixing materials or active focusing is needed. Barrel-material expansion also changes element spacing and must be counted together with the elements themselves. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Barrel interface and thermal expansion”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Asphere drawings follow the ISO 10110 series: the aspheric equation and coefficients, figure tolerance (PV, RMS and slope), mid-frequency PSD or band-limited RMS, roughness, centring tolerance and centre thickness, each with its measurement method and the fitted terms removed (for example tilt and defocus). The acceptance report must state measurement uncertainty, which by convention should be below a quarter of the tolerance (a 4:1 test-uncertainty ratio); when that cannot be reached, the metrology must improve or two independent methods must cross-validate. The handoff package also includes the measured sag table or figure map so the optical designer can re-optimise with as-built data. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ISO 10110 drawing and measurement uncertainty”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若把非球面係數的符號約定或單位搞錯（例如把 A₄ 以 mm⁻³ 當成 mm⁻⁴），加工出的表面在邊緣偏離設計數十微米，量測時整片表面看似合格的球面卻完全不是設計的非球面。
CGH 若相對干涉儀偏心 20 µm，量到的面形會多出一個假的彗差項，修形機台照著去除後反而把真正合格的表面做壞，下一次量測又顯示相反方向的彗差。
pitfallsEn: A sign-convention or unit error in the aspheric coefficients (for example treating A₄ in mm⁻³ as mm⁻⁴) produces a surface tens of micrometres off design at the edge, and metrology shows a seemingly fine sphere that is simply not the asphere designed.

A CGH decentred by 20 µm relative to the interferometer adds a spurious coma term to the measured figure; the figuring machine removes it faithfully and spoils a surface that was actually within tolerance, and the next measurement shows coma of the opposite sign.

related.title: 自由曲面光學量測
related.transfer: 可遷移「為何需要非球面：矢高、偏離量與斜率」與「非球面量測：輪廓儀、CGH 干涉與拼接」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；自由曲面光學量測的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Why aspheres: sag, departure and slope" and "Asphere metrology: profilometry, CGH interferometry and stitching" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Freeform-optics metrology must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦非球面矢高方程、中頻誤差、確定性拋光、鑽石車削與模造、非球面量測與對心公差；自由曲面光學量測則以自由曲面的基準配準、CGH 與傾斜波干涉、探針輪廓、拼接與不確定度追溯為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on aspheric sag equation, mid-spatial-frequency error, deterministic polishing, diamond turning and molding, asphere metrology and centring tolerances; Freeform-optics metrology centres on datum registration, CGH and tilted-wave interferometry, probe profiling, stitching and traceable uncertainty for freeform surfaces, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「非球面矢高方程與圓錐常數」與「自由曲面定義與基準座標」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到自由曲面光學量測，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「量測不確定度預算與追溯」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Aspheric sag equation and conic constant” and “Freeform definition and datum frame”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Freeform-optics metrology, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Measurement-uncertainty budget and traceability", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 磁流變光學拋光
related.transfer: 可遷移「為何需要非球面：矢高、偏離量與斜率」與「非球面量測：輪廓儀、CGH 干涉與拼接」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；磁流變光學拋光的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Why aspheres: sag, departure and slope" and "Asphere metrology: profilometry, CGH interferometry and stitching" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Magnetorheological optical finishing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦非球面矢高方程、中頻誤差、確定性拋光、鑽石車削與模造、非球面量測與對心公差；磁流變光學拋光則以以磁場硬化的磁流變液帶、Preston 去除關係與去除點校正，確定性修正非球面面形為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on aspheric sag equation, mid-spatial-frequency error, deterministic polishing, diamond turning and molding, asphere metrology and centring tolerances; Magnetorheological optical finishing centres on deterministic aspheric figure correction with a field-stiffened MR ribbon, Preston removal relation and spot calibration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「非球面矢高方程與圓錐常數」與「磁流變液帶與電磁鐵」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到磁流變光學拋光，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「誤差預算、收斂率與軌跡紋理」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Aspheric sag equation and conic constant” and “MR ribbon and electromagnet”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Magnetorheological optical finishing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Error budget, convergence ratio and tool-path texture", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 非球面光學加工
history.text: 笛卡兒在 1637 年已描述能消球差的非球面，但長期無法加工；1930 年施密特以真空變形法做出施密特校正板，1960 年代美國實驗室與機床廠發展出單點鑽石車削，1970 年代電腦全像片開始用於非球面零位測試，1980 年代起精密玻璃模造讓小口徑玻璃非球面進入量產，1990 年代羅徹斯特發展的磁流變拋光把確定性修形帶入工業。今天從智慧型手機的塑膠非球面到微影鏡頭的大型非球面都依賴這些方法。本課只重建公開的工程原理。
history.textEn: Descartes described spherical-aberration-free aspheric surfaces as early as 1637, but they remained unmanufacturable for centuries; Schmidt made his corrector plate by vacuum deformation in 1930, single-point diamond turning emerged from US laboratories and machine builders in the 1960s, computer-generated holograms entered aspheric null testing in the 1970s, precision glass molding brought small glass aspheres into volume production from the 1980s, and magnetorheological finishing developed in Rochester in the 1990s brought deterministic figuring to industry. Today everything from plastic smartphone aspheres to large lithography aspheres relies on these methods. This course reconstructs only public engineering principles.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「為何需要非球面：矢高、偏離量與斜率」到「非球面圖面規格、量測比與驗收交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Why aspheres: sag, departure and slope" through "Asphere drawing specification, test-uncertainty ratio and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
